title: Commission delivers more than €210 million to support over 700 researchers to build their careers in Europe
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 01 Oct 2026 More than 700 additional researchers will be able to build their careers in Europe thanks to an additional boost of over €210 million to the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) – one of Europe's flagship programmes for research careers. The funding is part of Choose Europe, the European Commission's initiative to position the EU as the main global magnet for scientific talent, research, and technological innovation.
